title: Random Tensor Estimates and Deterministic Diagonal Resolutions for Mixed Paracontrolled Operators
summary: We prove an operator-level convergence theorem for the mixed paracontrolled blocks \[ T^{i;j,k}_Λ(w) =I_i\bigl(w<Ψ_{j,Λ}\bigr)\circΨ_{k,Λ} \] on \(\mathbb T^d\), under Fourier-diagonal Gaussian covariance. At finite Galerkin cutoff, the Wick decomposition is \[ T^τ_Λ=D^τ_Λ+B^τ_Λ, \qquad τ=(i;j,k), \] where \(D^τ_Λ\) is a deterministic Volterra multiplier on the external diagonal \(n=q\), while \(B^τ_Λ\) is a centered second homogeneous Gaussian chaos with incidence \(n=q+\ell+r\).
